title: Pandiya Naadu
desc: Sivakumar, a young man, lives in a close-knit family. When a criminal kills his brother, he and his father decide to take revenge but in their own separate ways.

title: The Warriorr
desc: Satya, a doctor, is brutally beaten and driven out of his city by Guru, a ruthless gangster. However, Satya returns two years later as a police officer to exact revenge on Guru.

title: Viduthalai Part 2
desc: After being captured by the police, the rebellious Perumal Vaathiyaar comes clean about his past and his ascension to power.

title: Anjaan
desc: Krishna travels to Mumbai to look for his missing brother Raju. However, things take a turn when learns that Raju was a notorious gangster in the city.

title: Kuruvi
desc: Vitrivel becomes caught in a web of crime and violence when he tracks down a man who holds his father as bonded labour along with many innocent people.
